anchors.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
anchors.reason: EEG-BIDS is a data-organization standard/specification the dataset follows, not a paper describing the BCI-FIT ALS dataset.

metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded with Wearable Sensing dry-electrode caps (DSI-Flex or DSI-24) via Lab Streaming Layer at 300 Hz, then downsampled to 150 Hz and filtered at 1-20 Hz with a 60 Hz notch. Tasks were run with BciPy 2.0 using Matrix and RSVP typing layouts. Calibration used 55 inquiries of 14 characters presented at 5 Hz. Copy-spelling required participants to copy five-letter words, with adaptive stopping based on a classifier confidence threshold of 0.8.
